title: Reckless Driving
grade_or_penalty: Motor vehicle violation; 5 points; 1st offense up to 60 days jail and/or $50-$200 fine
key_points: Driving heedlessly, in willful or wanton disregard of the rights or safety of others, endangering people or property.
elements: Heedlessly, in willful or wanton disregard of the rights or safety of others
In a manner that endangered, or was likely to endanger, a person or property
